snippet.title: BlindSide Audio Adventure Game - Play Demo
snippet.description:
BlindSide is a survival/horror adventure game with no graphics at all. Navigate a 3D world using only your ears and what's between them. Now on iPhone!

It uses the iPhone gyroscopes so you just face the direction you want to go, and the world rotates around you. Put on headphones for this demo to make sense.

You can find BlindSide on the app store or find more information at www.blindsidegame.com
